recommended_actions: Make booking slot or run order an explicit dispatch choice, then validate it against each job's reservation window.
Let players replay dispatch from the terminal to improve the empty-run meter, or attach a meaningful mastery threshold to the outcome while preserving hard-rule priority.
Apply per-screen ruby to first appearances such as 吊り, 検数, 背高, 搬出, 規程, and 納入.
Condense dispatch success and wrap-up copy to at most two explanation blocks per screen.
Rename or re-document checkOk as an internal fixture-coherence field so the code no longer suggests a shipped check-digit aid.
